title: CrossTPA
description: CrossTPA is a high-performance, cross-platform teleportation suite that seamlessly bridges the gap between Java and Bedrock players with interactive GUIs and robust economy integration.
body:
CrossTPA is a professional-grade Minecraft Paper plugin that bridges Java and Bedrock Edition players for a seamless teleportation experience.

🎮 True Universal Support: Features premium Java Chest GUIs (exploit-proof) and native Bedrock Forms for intuitive, cross-platform interaction.
💰 Smart Economy & Privacy: Integrated with Vault for paid teleports with automatic refunds, plus a robust Block/Mute system for player privacy.
🛡️ Safety & Visuals: Includes Hazard Prevention (lava/void detection), invincibility timers, and high-quality visuals like BossBars, Particles, and ActionBars.
📋 Pro Admin Tools: Equipped with Admin Spy, complete Teleport History, and easy-to-use reload commands.
⚙️ Zero-Dependency Core: Optimized for Paper 1.20+ with all external plugins (Floodgate/Vault) set as Soft Dependencies, meaning the plugin works on any server out-of-the-box.
